entities.summary: Tina Karol (b. 1985-01-25, Orotukan) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Orotukan and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, composers & musicians, europe.
